status: Pilot construction assignments only; no generated or validated cases and no claimed achieved coverage.
provenance: Manual campaign planning; prompts, seeds and updated cards must be authored by the separate Sonnet construction agent.
comparison_policy: Use existing baseline runs where comparable. Do not generate easy controls for newly authored or adapted cases. Report adapted-prompt comparisons as adapted variants, not environment-only causal pairs.
selection_policy: Fixed purposive feasibility pilot covering seven referent roots, all four modes, relation counts, long routes and workspace scope. No ground-truth run labels or solver outcomes were consulted to choose assignments.

authoring_policy.auxiliary_criteria: Up to two author-chosen criteria; preserve an existing compound baseline's content restrictions.
authoring_policy.underspecified: Partial information must remain on the focal field/path; competing candidate sets require clarification without delegated choice.
authoring_policy.near_miss: A plausible focal negative satisfies all auxiliary criteria and violates the focal predicate. For ambiguity, competing positive selections are not themselves negatives.
authoring_policy.coverage_credit: Only concrete validated cases earn coverage. Source witnesses and construction claims do not earn credit.

conditional_followups.condition: The enriched P01 case is valid and its solver run has an accepted evaluator assessment with no demonstrated grounding failure. An invalid case or failed evaluation does not satisfy this gate.
conditional_followups.counting: One additional construction/run beyond the 14 initial assignments, only if the gate is met; not an easy-control run.
